_comment: Phase 8F Spanish regional terminology model (docs/PHASE-8F-SPANISH-REGIONAL-SEO.md). This is a SEO/lexical data source, not a translation-content store and not a second translation-status system -- it records which Spanish TERM to prefer for a given semantic concept, in a given region, for a given use (SEO metadata, natural body copy, FAQ, internal-link anchor), backed by cited evidence. It does not decide whether a page exists in Spanish (see data/i18n/translation-status.json for that). Regions where no material distinction was found are intentionally left undifferentiated -- see Section 3 of the docs: 'Do not force a country-level distinction when the evidence does not support one.'

concepts.notes: The three-way piscina/alberca/pileta distinction is the clearest, best-evidenced regional split found. Do not collapse into one string; do not stuff all three into running body copy (see docs Section 6).

evidence: RAE: 'construcción que contiene agua... destinada al baño'

variants.notes: Classified by the Academia Mexicana de la Lengua as a synchronic Mexicanism ('piscina deportiva'); dominant in Mexico across registers, including construction-industry usage.

variants.notes: Rioplatense term (Argentina, Uruguay, and to a lesser extent Paraguay). Also colloquially means 'sink' in general Spanish -- disambiguate with pool-specific surrounding context (e.g. 'pileta de natación') where ambiguity is possible outside a clearly pool-related page.
evidence: Real Academia Española, DLE (pileta, regional marks Arg./Bol./Par./Ur.): https://dle.rae.es/pileta

concepts.notes: A more formal/technical qualifier, useful for disambiguating 'pileta' from its 'sink' sense or for higher-register copy; not a regional variant of 'pool' itself.

concepts.notes: IMPORTANT content-accuracy finding, not just a stylistic choice: 'bañera de hidromasaje'/'tina de hidromasaje' (used as the primary term on Jacuzzi(R)'s own es-mx/es-es sites) name a DIFFERENT, smaller product -- an indoor, 1-2 person bathroom fixture with no continuous filtration, drained after each use. WaterBalanceTools' hot-tub calculators concern a continuously-filled, filtered, heated, chemically-treated multi-person vessel that actually needs ongoing chlorine/pH management -- that is the 'spa' concept below, matching this site's existing Phase 8E Spanish copy ('Spa / Jacuzzi', 'Calculadora ... para Spa'), which this research confirms was already correct. See the separate 'hydromassage_bathtub' concept for the drain-after-use fixture, kept intentionally distinct so it is never substituted for 'hot tub' in a chemistry-maintenance context.

evidence: Jacuzzi(R) Spain's own site uses 'spa' as its primary category label: https://www.jacuzzi.com/es-es/spas
Jacuzzi Chile uses 'spa' as its primary category: https://jacuzzi.cl/categoria/spa/

variants.notes: Registered trademark (RAE confirms: 'jacuzzi... Marca reg.'), genericized in everyday Latin American usage to the point of being applied even to unrelated products (bañeras de hidromasaje sold colloquially as 'jacuzzis'). Model as a high-value SEARCH/lexical variant for matching real user queries -- never as the canonical or primary body-copy term.
evidence: RAE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas (yacusi): https://www.rae.es/dpd/yacusi

variants.notes: RAE-recommended Hispanicized spelling of 'jacuzzi'. Rare in real-world search/commercial usage compared to 'jacuzzi' itself; kept for completeness and dictionary-correctness, not as an SEO priority.
evidence: RAE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas: https://www.rae.es/dpd/yacusi

variants.notes: Generic descriptor for the water-jet massage function itself; in real usage typically appears adjectivally ('spa de hidromasaje', 'bañera de hidromasaje') rather than standing alone as the product name.

concepts.notes: Deliberately modeled as DISTINCT from 'hot_tub' above, not a regional synonym of it. An indoor, 1-2 person bathroom fixture without a continuous filtration/heating cycle, drained after each use. Not relevant to WaterBalanceTools' chemistry-maintenance calculators; kept in this file only so a future page/content generator can positively recognize the term and avoid mis-mapping it onto the hot_tub concept.
